criteria.statement: A valid mounted-config reload completes within the existing OS process and does not require container replacement.
A replacement application is fully constructed before the current application is cancelled, and the replacement does not start until current in-flight work has drained.
A parse, validation, adapter, or replacement-initialization failure leaves the prior application and active config unchanged.
In-place mutable adapter reload validates before atomically publishing the candidate config and is race-free with shutdown reads.
Durable state remains available across the in-process application handoff, and live acceptance proves unchanged PID plus healthy /health and /ready before and after reload.
